recentItems.title: Athletics Kenya masters team returns after impressive showing in Daegu, South Korea
recentItems.description:
The Athletics Kenya masters team returned home jubilantly after stopping the show in Daegu South Korea for the 2026 world masters athletics championships.
With an insatiable appetite for success in old age, the veteran athletes concluded their global campaign with an impressive haul of 27 medals, 15 gold, 6 silver and 6 bronze.
The stellar display in the Asian country showed a massive improvement from the 2024 edition in Gothenburg, Sweden, where Kenya bagged 24 medals that included 7 golds.

recentItems.title: Senator Seki demands community representation in any deal for Magadi
recentItems.description:
Kajiado Senator Samuel Seki has demanded THE full inclusion of the Magadi Community in discussions on any new deal to replace Tata Chemicals. This comes just days after President William Ruto ordered the Trona mining company, Tata Chemicals, to pack up and leave Magadi.
Speaking during a thanksgiving ceremony in Kajiado South, Senator Seki said while he supports reforms in the mining sector, the Magadi community must not be sidelined in the search for a new investor. Seki wants the national government to ensure any new investor agreement includes clear benefits for the local community - including water provision, health care, education, employment for the youth and a fair share of royalties.

recentItems.title: Counties step up preparations ahead of El Niño rains
recentItems.description: The country remains on high alert following a warning by the Kenya Meteorological Department of heavy El Niño rainfall from October through to December 2026. According to the Kenya Red Cross disaster risk reduction manager, Peter Murgor, 46 counties are at risk, with over 2 million people likely to be affected. From Nairobi County, which is racing against time to unclog its drainage systems, to Garissa, where proactive strategies are being stepped up. Our reporter, Serfine Achieng Ouma, set out to monitor preparations for the projected adverse weather phenomenon.

recentItems.title: PS Muthoni warns against politicisation of SHA
recentItems.description:
A section of leaders from the Mt Kenya region have warned their counterparts against politicising Kenya's public health insurance, SHA
Led by Health Principal Secretary Mary Muthoni and Nyeri governor Mutahi Kahiga, the leaders called on Kenyans to register for the cover, arguing that health remains an individual and not collective responsibility. The rallying came during a Jamii Imara mashinani mop-up exercise by the PS at the Nyeri National polytechnic, where government allied leaders heaped praise on President William Ruto's development track record in the larger Mt Kenya region. Muthoni said the President has kept the promises he made to Mt Kenya

recentItems.title: Nairobi ODM MPs dismiss claims Sakaja will get direct ticket
recentItems.description: A section of ODM MPs have downplayed claims that Nairobi Governor Johnson Sakaja will ditch the UDA party for ODM. Led by county chairman and Maka-Dara MP George Aladwa, the MPs insisted that the party will field a competitively selected candidate. Nominated Senator Hamadi Kibwana said if Sakaja joins ODM, he should prepare for nominations, adding that there will be no direct tickets.

recentItems.title: Bishop Margaret Wanjiru joins governor’s race
recentItems.description: Politician and Bishop of Jesus Is Alive Ministries, Margaret Wanjiru, has declared her Candidature for the Nairobi Governor's seat. Bishop Wanjiru says she will work with the opposition in a bid to secure the seat. She pledged to tackle what she described as the mess in Nairobi, promising to address challenges ranging from environmental degradation to corruption and poor governance.
